text:
maria_cs: Quick day0 pulse for Zenith Labs — we're blocked on KMS key policy sign-off from their security team; they flagged cross-account IAM bindings and audit log sink. Go/no-go for Tuesday cutover?

jake_se: From infra side: networking is green (VPN + peering tested), but audit log forwarding to their SIEM needs a signed cert. Also they want log retention 5 yrs — that impacts storage + cost :thinking:

olga_security: We flagged the KMS policy because the key currently allows AccountPrincipal 'arn:aws:iam::REDCORP:role/RedwoodServiceRole' — they want an explicit condition on the encryption context to limit usage to this deployment. Example policy tweak below:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowUseForZenith",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCORP:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:deployment_id": "zenith-prod"}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

jake_se: Yep we can add that condition. I can push to preview infra and run the deploy check. Command I'll use: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id <id> --policy file://zenith-kms-policy.json`

deploy-bot: preview infra deploy started for vpc-zenith-preview — checks queued (networking, certs, audit-sink)

tim_ops: Renewal watch FYI — Zenith mentioned pausing if go-live slips >2 weeks. Suggest contingency options: 1) temporary retention reduction (90d), 2) cost delta estimate, 3) offer dedicated onboarding support first month.

maria_cs: I'll propose contingency in tomorrow sync. Jake — can you draft the cost delta 90d vs 5yr?

jake_se: On it. Quick calc from sample volume: 5 yr retention ~= $24k/mo additional storage; 90d ~= $1.2k/mo. I'll DM the spreadsheet and break down S3 vs warm storage.

olga_security: Also need them to sign our cross-account KMS addendum (SOC/PCI language). If legal refuses, fallback is customer-managed CMK in their account — more ops time. I'll attach template.

maria_cs: Decision path for now: keep Tue cutover target but KMS policy change must be in preview by EOD Mon. Owners: Jake = implement preview policy, Olga = send addendum, Tim = draft contingency offer + exec note. @zenith_security can you confirm estimated sign-off windows?

zenith_security: zenith_security: We can review the policy Mon morning. Legal needs ~48h for addendum review but we'll try to fast-track and update by Monday afternoon.

maria_cs: Thanks — will keep renewal stakeholders updated. Small ops ask: please update runbook 'priv-deploy/runbooks/zenith' to include a KMS fallback path (customer CMK steps + who to ping). I'll open a PR now.

jake_se: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/runbooks/pulls/42 — includes policy diff, cert steps, and audit-sink retry logic. PTAL.

deploy-bot: CI checks passed for PR #42. Preview infra deployed to vpc-zenith-preview. Audit sink healthy -> /var/log/redwood/audit/zenith/ (last 30m OK)

tim_ops: Marked renewal risk = high in Monday exec digest. Will add a short blurb with contingency options and the timeline risk if addendum delayed.

maria_cs: Great — thanks all. We'll reconvene Mon 9am PT if we don't have sign-off earlier.
